# montecarlo_self_hosted_aws_credentials (Data Source)

AWS Secrets Manager credentials point a connection at a secret in your AWS Secrets Manager. Monte Carlo stores the reference, not the secret, and reads the secret each time the connection is used.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `assumable_role` (String) ARN of the role the deployment assumes to read the secret. Null when unset.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region of the secret. Null when unset.
- `aws_secret` (String) Name or ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret holding the connection's credentials.
- `bq_project_id` (String) BigQuery project the connection reads from. Null unless set.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `external_id` (String) External id presented when assuming the role. Null when unset.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `sql_warehouse_id` (String) Databricks SQL warehouse the connection runs queries on. Null unless set.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
